The CRT daily open structure suggests that after failing to expand above 1.1622, the price must expand downwards to seek liquidity. This is validated by the flat Ichimoku cloud and low ADX, confirming range-bound mechanics where price oscillates between the defensive staff (1.1622) and the liquidity pool (1.1612/1.1601).
